meals.recipe_name: Greek Yogurt Protein Pancakes with Berries
recipe_steps: Add 1 cup rolled oats to a blender and blend on high for 30 seconds until a fine flour forms.
Add the eggs, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1 tsp baking powder, and 1/3 cup milk to the blender. Blend 20 seconds until smooth; let batter rest 5 minutes to thicken.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat (about 350F) and melt 1/2 tbsp of the butter.

Pour 1/4-cup portions of batter into the skillet. Cook 2 minutes until bubbles form on the surface and edges set, then flip and cook 1.5 minutes more. Repeat with remaining butter and batter (makes ~4 pancakes).
Stack pancakes, top with 1/2 cup mixed berries, and drizzle with 2 tbsp maple syrup. Serve immediately.
Slice 8 oz chicken breast into 1/2-inch strips. Mince 2 garlic cloves and grate 1 tsp ginger.
Whisk 3 tbsp soy sauce, 1.5 tbsp honey, garlic, ginger, and 1 tsp cornstarch dissolved in 2 tbsp water in a small bowl.
Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a wok over high heat. Add chicken and stir-fry 5 minutes until browned and cooked to 165F internal.
Add 1 cup broccoli florets and stir-fry 2 minutes. Pour in the sauce and cook 2 minutes until glossy and thickened.
Serve over 1.5 cups warm cooked rice and sprinkle with 1 tsp sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Sunday night to fully thaw for Monday lunch.
Rinse 1.5 cups white rice until water runs clear, combine with 2.25 cups water, bring to boil, cover, simmer 18 min, rest 10 min. Refrigerate in sealed container for the week.

meals.recipe_name: Pan-Seared Salmon with Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipe_steps: Peel and cube 12 oz potatoes. Boil in salted water 15 minutes until fork-tender, then drain.
Mash potatoes with 2 tbsp butter, 1/4 cup milk, and 2 minced garlic cloves. Season with salt and pepper; keep warm.
Pat salmon dry and season both sides with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat.
Place salmon skin-side down and sear 4 minutes without moving, then flip and cook 3 minutes to 125F internal for medium.
Toss asparagus in the pan for the last 3 minutes. Plate salmon over mash, add asparagus, and squeeze 1/2 lemon over top.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Sunday night to thaw for Monday dinner.

recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Slice 1 banana over the top and scatter 1/4 cup almonds.
Drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and serve immediately.
Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana, and 1 cup ice to a blender.
Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth. Pour and serve immediately.
Make tortillas: mix 1.25 cups flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil, and 1/2 cup warm water into a dough. Knead 5 min, rest 15 min covered.
Divide dough into 2 balls, roll each into a thin 9-inch round. Cook each in a dry hot skillet 1 minute per side until puffed and spotted; keep warm.
Whisk 4 eggs with a pinch of salt. Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low and scramble eggs softly for 3 minutes.
Warm 1/2 cup black beans. Lay tortillas out, divide eggs, beans, 1/3 cup cheddar, and 1/4 cup salsa between them.
Fold in sides and roll tightly. Sear seam-side down in the pan 1 minute to seal. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Make dough morning-of and rest 15 min while prepping fillings; fresh dough gives best texture.

recipe_steps: Boil 6 oz baby potatoes 12 minutes; add 2 eggs for the last 8 minutes. Add green beans for the final 3 minutes. Drain and cool under cold water.
Peel and halve eggs; halve potatoes; halve 1 cup cherry tomatoes.
Whisk 2 tbsp olive oil, juice of 1/2 lemon, and 1 tsp Dijon into a dressing.
Arrange 2 cups greens on a plate, top with drained tuna, potatoes, green beans, tomatoes, and eggs.
Drizzle with dressing and serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Beef and Bell Pepper Stir-Fry over Rice
recipe_steps: Slice 8 oz flank steak thinly against the grain. Toss with 1 tsp cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce.
Slice 2 bell peppers and 1/2 onion. Mince 2 garlic cloves. Mix remaining 2 tbsp soy sauce with 1 tbsp oyster sauce.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat until smoking. Sear beef 2 minutes until browned; remove.
Add 1 tbsp oil, stir-fry peppers, onion, and garlic 3 minutes. Return beef, add sauce, toss 1 minute.
Serve over 1.5 cups warm rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz flank steak from freezer to fridge Monday night to thaw for Tuesday dinner.

recipe_steps: Layer half the 1 cup Greek yogurt in a glass.
Add 1/4 cup granola and 1/4 cup berries. Repeat layers.
Drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and serve.
Take the jar prepared the night before out of the fridge.
Stir in 1 tbsp peanut butter and eat cold.

prep_tasks.instructions: Combine 3/4 cup rolled oats, 1 scoop chocolate whey, 1 cup milk, and 1 tbsp chia seeds in a jar Monday night. Stir, cover, refrigerate.

recipe_steps: Dice 1/2 onion and 1 bell pepper; mince 2 garlic cloves.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium. Saute onion and pepper 5 minutes, add garlic, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika, cook 1 minute.
Pour in 1.5 cups crushed tomatoes, simmer 8 minutes until thickened.
Make 3 wells and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook 6 minutes until whites set but yolks runny.
Crumble 1/3 cup feta over top. Serve with 2 slices toasted bread.
Boil 3 oz penne in salted water 11 minutes until al dente; reserve 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Brown 7 oz ground turkey with 2 minced garlic cloves for 6 minutes to 165F.
Add 1 cup halved cherry tomatoes, cook 2 minutes until softened.
Lower heat, stir in 3 tbsp pesto, drained pasta, and a splash of pasta water to loosen.
Top with 1/4 cup parmesan and serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Tuesday night to thaw for Wednesday lunch.

recipe_steps: Rinse 3/4 cup quinoa, combine with 1.5 cups water, boil, cover, simmer 15 minutes until fluffy.
Pat 9 oz shrimp dry. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high, sear shrimp 2 minutes per side until pink; remove.
Lower heat, melt 2 tbsp butter, add 3 minced garlic cloves, cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add 2 cups spinach and wilt 1 minute. Return shrimp, squeeze in juice of 1 lemon.
Serve shrimp over quinoa, garnished with 2 tbsp parsley.

prep_tasks.instructions: Cold-water thaw 9 oz shrimp Wednesday afternoon: seal in a bag, submerge in cold water ~20 min, changing water once.

recipe_steps: Toast 2 slices of bread until golden.
Spread 3/4 cup cottage cheese over toast.
Top with 2 tbsp chopped walnuts and drizzle with 1 tbsp honey.
Add 1 scoop vanilla whey, 1/2 cup Greek yogurt, 1 cup berries, 1 cup milk, and 1 tbsp honey to a blender.
Blend on high 40 seconds until smooth and serve.
Dice 8 oz potatoes small, 1 bell pepper, and 1/2 onion.
Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium-high. Fry potatoes 8 minutes until crisp and golden.
Add pepper, onion, 1 tsp paprika, salt; cook 4 minutes. Push aside and brown 6 oz bison 5 minutes to 160F, breaking it up.
Make 2 wells, crack in eggs, cover, cook 4 minutes until whites set.
Serve hot from the skillet.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge Wednesday night to thaw for Thursday breakfast.

recipe_steps: Make wrap dough: combine 1.25 cups flour, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 cup warm water. Knead 5 min, rest 15 min.
Roll into 2 large thin rounds, cook each in a dry hot skillet 1 min per side; keep warm.
Season 7 oz chicken breast with salt, sear in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high 5 minutes per side to 165F; slice.
Toss 2 cups chopped romaine with 3 tbsp Caesar dressing and 1/4 cup parmesan.
Fill wraps with chicken and salad, roll tightly, and serve.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 7 oz chicken breast from freezer to fridge Wednesday night to thaw for Thursday lunch.

meals.recipe_name: Pork Tenderloin with Sweet Potato Mash
recipe_steps: Peel and cube 12 oz sweet potatoes, boil 15 minutes until tender, drain, mash with 1 tbsp butter and salt.
Season 8 oz pork tenderloin with salt and 1 tsp rosemary. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in an ovenproof skillet over high heat.
Sear pork on all sides 6 minutes, then transfer skillet to a 400F oven for 10 minutes until 145F internal. Rest 5 minutes.
In the same pan, melt 1 tbsp butter, add 2 minced garlic cloves and green beans, saute 4 minutes.
Slice pork and serve over sweet potato mash with green beans.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz pork tenderloin from freezer to fridge Wednesday night to thaw for Thursday dinner.

recipe_steps: Halve 1 cucumber lengthwise and scoop out seeds to form boats.
Mix drained tuna with 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, 1 tsp Dijon, and juice of 1/2 lemon.
Spoon tuna mix into cucumber boats and serve.
Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop chocolate whey, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 banana, and 1/4 cup oats to a blender.
Blend on high 45 seconds until smooth and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Smoked Salmon Cream Cheese Bagel Scramble
recipe_steps: Whisk 3 eggs. Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low heat.
Add eggs and stir gently 2 minutes; when just barely set, fold in 2 tbsp cream cheese in small dollops and 3 oz torn smoked salmon.
Cook 1 more minute until creamy. Fold in 1 tbsp chives.
Toast 2 slices bread. Plate scramble over toast, garnish with 1 tsp capers. Serve immediately.

meals.recipe_name: Beef Burger with Sweet Potato Fries
recipe_steps: Bun (made day-of from frozen dough): thaw dough ball, shape into a bun, proof 1 hour, bake at 375F for 15 minutes until golden.
Cut 8 oz sweet potato into fries, toss with 1 tbsp olive oil and salt, roast at 425F for 25 minutes, flipping halfway.
Form 8 oz ground beef into a patty, season with salt. Sear in 1 tbsp oil over high heat 3 minutes per side to 160F; add cheddar to melt in last minute.
Slice and toast bun. Assemble with lettuce, tomato, and patty.
Serve with sweet potato fries.

prep_tasks.instructions: Monday: mix 1.5 cups flour, 1 tsp yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 cup warm water. Knead 8 min, portion into a bun ball, freeze in a sealed bag.
Move frozen bun dough ball to fridge Thursday night to thaw for Friday shaping and proofing.
Move 8 oz ground beef from freezer to fridge Thursday night to thaw for Friday lunch.

meals.recipe_name: Miso Glazed Salmon with Bok Choy and Rice
recipe_steps: Whisk 2 tbsp miso, 1 tbsp honey, and 1 tbsp soy sauce into a glaze.
Pat salmon dry, brush with half the glaze. Broil on high 8 minutes until caramelized and 125F internal.
Heat 1 tbsp sesame oil in a pan, saute 2 minced garlic cloves and halved bok choy 4 minutes until tender-crisp.
Warm 1.5 cups rice. Plate salmon with remaining glaze, bok choy, and rice.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz salmon fillet from freezer to fridge Thursday night to thaw for Friday dinner.

recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup pineapple chunks and 1/4 cup almonds. Serve.
Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 2 tbsp almond butter, and 1 banana to a blender.
Blend on high 40 seconds until smooth and serve.

meals.recipe_name: Steak and Eggs with Home Fries
recipe_steps: Dice 8 oz potatoes, fry in 2 tbsp olive oil over medium-high 10 minutes with 1 tsp paprika and salt until crispy.
Season 6 oz flank steak with salt. Sear in a hot skillet 3 minutes per side to 130F, rest 5 minutes, slice thin.
Fry 3 eggs in 1 tbsp butter to desired doneness.
Plate steak, eggs, and home fries together. Serve hot.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 6 oz flank steak from freezer to fridge Friday night to thaw for Saturday breakfast.

recipe_steps: Make tortillas: mix 1 cup masa harina with 3/4 cup warm water into a dough, rest 10 min. Form 6 balls, press flat, cook on a dry griddle 45 sec per side.
Toss 8 oz shrimp with 1 tsp chili powder and 1 tsp cumin. Sear in 1 tbsp olive oil over high heat 2 minutes per side until pink.
Mix 2 cups shredded cabbage with 1/4 cup Greek yogurt and juice of 1/2 lime for slaw.
Fill tortillas with shrimp and slaw, top with cilantro and remaining lime. Serve immediately.

prep_tasks.instructions: Cold-water thaw 8 oz shrimp Saturday morning: seal in a bag, submerge in cold water ~20 min, changing water once.

meals.recipe_name: Herb Roasted Chicken Thighs with Couscous
recipe_steps: Pat 10 oz chicken thighs dry, rub with 1 tbsp olive oil, 3 minced garlic cloves, 1 tsp rosemary, and salt.
Sear thighs skin-side down in an ovenproof skillet 5 minutes, flip, then roast at 425F for 20 minutes to 175F internal.
Add sliced zucchini and 1 cup cherry tomatoes with 1 tbsp olive oil to the skillet for the last 12 minutes.
Pour 3/4 cup couscous into a bowl with 1 cup boiling water, cover 5 minutes, fluff with a fork.
Serve chicken and vegetables over couscous with juice of 1 lemon.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 10 oz chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Friday night to thaw for Saturday dinner.

recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup berries, 2 tbsp walnuts, and 1 tbsp honey. Serve.
Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop chocolate whey, 1/3 cup oats, 1 tbsp peanut butter, and 1 banana to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until smooth and serve.
Season 4 oz ground turkey with 1/2 tsp fennel seed and 1/2 tsp paprika. Brown in a skillet 6 minutes to 165F, breaking it up; set aside.
Whisk 4 eggs. Melt 1 tbsp butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low, pour in eggs, tilt to spread.
When nearly set (2 minutes), add turkey, 1 cup spinach, and 1/3 cup cheddar to one half.
Fold omelette over the filling, cook 1 minute more. Serve with 1 slice toast.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 4 oz ground turkey from freezer to fridge Saturday night to thaw for Sunday breakfast.

recipe_steps: Cornbread: mix 3/4 cup cornmeal, 1/2 cup flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 1/2 cup milk, 1 tbsp oil. Pour into a small pan, bake at 400F for 18 minutes.
Dice 1/2 onion, saute in 1 tbsp oil 3 minutes. Add 8 oz bison, brown 6 minutes to 160F.
Stir in 1 tbsp chili powder, 1 cup crushed tomatoes, and 3/4 cup kidney beans. Simmer 15 minutes.
Serve chili hot with a wedge of fresh cornbread.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 8 oz ground bison from freezer to fridge Saturday night to thaw for Sunday lunch.

meals.recipe_name: Honey Garlic Chicken with Jasmine Rice
recipe_steps: Cut 9 oz chicken thighs into chunks. Whisk 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 3 minced garlic cloves, and 1 tbsp rice vinegar.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high, cook chicken 7 minutes until golden and 165F.
Add 1 cup broccoli, cook 3 minutes. Pour in sauce, simmer 3 minutes until sticky.
Serve over 1.5 cups warm rice, sprinkled with 1 tsp sesame seeds.

prep_tasks.instructions: Move 9 oz boneless chicken thighs from freezer to fridge Saturday night to thaw for Sunday dinner.

recipe_steps: Spoon 1 cup cottage cheese into a bowl.
Top with 1/2 cup berries, 1/4 cup granola, and 1 tbsp honey. Serve.
Add 1.5 cups milk, 1 scoop vanilla whey, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1/4 cup oats, and 1 banana to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until smooth and serve.
